function.name: get_all_teams
function.description: Return all 30 NBA teams with IDs, names, abbreviations, and conference/division info.

function.name: get_team
function.description: Return detailed info for a single NBA team by its numeric ID.

function.name: search_player
function.description: Search for NBA players by name. Returns up to 10 matches with player IDs.

name.description: Full or partial player name, e.g. 'LeBron' or 'Stephen Curry'.

function.name: get_player_season_averages
function.description: Get per-game season averages (PTS, REB, AST, FG%, 3P%, etc.) for one or more players.

season.description: Season year, e.g. 2024 for the 2024-25 season.

function.name: compute_player_averages
function.description: Free-tier alternative to season_averages. Fetches raw box score game stats and computes per-game averages (pts, reb, ast, stl, blk, fg_pct, fg3_pct, ft_pct). Use this instead of get_player_season_averages on the free BallDontLie tier.

season.description: Season year, e.g. 2024 for the 2024-25 season.

last_n.description: If > 0, only average the last N games (e.g. 5 for recent form). Default 0 = full season.

function.name: get_player_game_stats
function.description: Get per-game box score stats for specific players, optionally filtered by season or game IDs.

seasons.description: Optional list of season years to filter by.

game_ids.description: Optional list of game IDs to filter by.

function.name: get_todays_games
function.description: Return all NBA games scheduled for today, including teams and current scores.

function.name: get_upcoming_games
function.description: Return all NBA games scheduled in the next N days.

days_ahead.description: Number of days to look ahead (default 7).

function.name: get_games
function.description: Fetch NBA games with optional filters for date, team IDs, and season.

date_str.description: Filter by a specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

team_ids.description: Filter by one or more team IDs.

seasons.description: Filter by one or more season years.

function.name: get_team_season_stats
function.description: Return all individual game stats for a team in a season — useful for calculating rolling form, home/away splits, and pace.

function.name: get_standings
function.description: Return conference and division standings including win/loss record, win percentage, and streak.

function.name: get_game_odds
function.description: Return moneyline, spread, and over/under betting odds for a specific game (requires All-Star API tier).

function.name: get_player_props
function.description: Return player prop bet lines (points, rebounds, assists, etc.) for a player in a specific game.
